### REQ-004: WhoAmI device identity

- **Status:** DONE
- **Added:** 2026-04-07
- **Completed:** 2026-04-07
- **Verified by:** idf.py build clean 2026-04-07
- **Depends on:** –
- **Description:**

Port the `WhoAmI` class (`include/whoami.h`, `src/whoami.cpp`) to ESP-IDF. This class provides device identity: hostname, IP address, MAC address, device ID (Base32-encoded MAC), and firmware version. It is used by Thermo for MQTT topics, status reporting, discovery messages, and the QR code URL.

#### Changes from legacy

- **MAC address**: Replace `WiFi.macAddress()` with `esp_read_mac()` or `WiFiManager::instance().getMAC()`.
- **IP address**: Replace `WiFi.localIP()` with `WiFiManager::instance().getIP()`.
- **Firmware version**: Replace Arduino build macros with `esp_app_get_description()->version`.
- **Hostname**: Derive from `HOSTNAMEPREFIX` + device ID, set via `esp_netif_set_hostname()` or `WiFiManager`.
- **Base32 encoding**: Pure C++ logic, no changes needed.

#### Replaces global `deviceId`

The current `main.cpp` uses a global `std::string deviceId` derived from WiFiManager. This must be replaced by `WhoAmI::GetDeviceId()` everywhere (main.cpp, OTA manager, status reporting, MQTT topics).

#### Location

`espidf/main/core/whoami.h` and `espidf/main/core/whoami.cpp`.

- **Acceptance criteria:**
  - [x] `WhoAmI` class compiles under ESP-IDF with no Arduino dependencies
  - [x] `GetDeviceId()` returns the same Base32-encoded MAC as the legacy implementation
  - [x] `GetHostName()` returns `THermo-{deviceId}`
  - [x] `GetIP()` returns the current WiFi IP (or placeholder if not connected)
  - [x] `GetMAC()` returns the MAC address string
  - [x] `GetVersion()` returns the firmware version from `esp_app_desc`
  - [x] Global `deviceId` variable in `main.cpp` is removed; all code uses `WhoAmI` instance
  - [x] OTA manager updated to use `WhoAmI` for device ID in MQTT topics
  - [x] Project builds cleanly
- **Notes:**
  `WhoAmI` has no dependency on Message, Configurable, or Room — it can be implemented and tested independently at any point.
